verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe Automations that schedule prompts to run automatically at recurring times (docs-5). Scheduled tasks in the Computer ecosystem run jobs such as weekday test runs and report failures (docs-14, docs-31). Personal webhooks notify users when long-running tasks finish (docs-48), which fits unattended background execution. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled automations run reliably, evidence of triggers beyond time-based schedules (e.g., event-driven), and detail on how unattended runs handle tool-approval gates.
